g.text: Within the same game: does hacking pay?
Gemini 3.7 Flash · 49-hole run · top: final score; bottom: score advantage over rivals
Each point is an episode; larger dots show overlaps. Centered within each game and phase. Hanabi excluded from rival leads.
Linear association, not a causal effect. Only 3 blind episodes per edition; hints are selected follow-ups on previous misses.
Removing four disclosed mechanisms + one cue from counts: final-score r = -0.02 blind / -0.06 hinted.
